message.content:
截至目前（2024 年），全球票房收入最高的电影是《阿凡達》（Avatar，2009）。该片在全球范围内累计票房约为 29 亿美元，超过了之前的纪录保持者《復仇者聯盟：終局之戰》（Avengers: Endgame，2019）和《泰坦尼克號》（Titanic，1997）。

> **注意**：如果按通货膨胀调整后的票房来计算，排名可能会有所不同，但就名义票房而言，《阿凡達》仍然是最高票房电影。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？" which translates to "What is the highest-grossing movie of all time?" They want the highest grossing movie worldwide. As of my knowledge cutoff (2024), the highest grossing movie worldwide is "Avatar" (2009) with about $2.92 billion. However, there might be updates after 2024? But we have no data beyond 2024. So answer: Avatar. Provide context. Also mention that "Avengers: Endgame" was second. Provide note about inflation adjustments. Also mention that "Avatar" regained top spot after re-release. Provide answer in Chinese.
